name: MA Bounce Off Level MES
description: Moving average rejection bounce — price tests a significant MA (20/50/200 EMA) acting as dynamic support or resistance, then rejects with a confirmed reversal candle. Entry on the rejection close candle. Wave 26 Pass G A1 archetype (migration 0151 backfilled 6 MA-as-S/R strategies to this archetype).
entry_condition: Price tests the 20 EMA (or 50/200 EMA) as dynamic S/R, prints a rejection candle (hammer/engulfing pattern) away from the MA, entry on close of rejection candle. Stop below/above the rejection wick.
